# stripe_checkout_session (Data Source)

A customer's session on a Stripe-hosted checkout page. Look one up by its `id`. The session's `line_items` are included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_checkout_session" "order" {
  id = "cs_test_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `adaptive_pricing` (Attributes) Settings for price localization with [Adaptive Pricing](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/adaptive-pricing). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--adaptive_pricing))
- `after_expiration` (Attributes) When set, provides configuration for actions to take if this Checkout Session expires. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--after_expiration))
- `allow_promotion_codes` (Boolean) Enables user redeemable promotion codes.
- `allowed_payment_method_types` (List of String) A list of the types of payment methods (e.g., `card`) this Checkout Session can accept.
- `amount_subtotal` (Number) Total of all items before discounts or taxes are applied.
- `amount_total` (Number) Total of all items after discounts and taxes are applied.
- `automatic_tax` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--automatic_tax))
- `billing_address_collection` (String) Describes whether Checkout should collect the customer's billing address. Defaults to `auto`. Possible values: `auto`, `required`.
- `branding_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branding_settings))
- `cancel_url` (String) If set, Checkout displays a back button and customers will be directed to this URL if they decide to cancel payment and return to your website.
- `client_reference_id` (String) A unique string to reference the Checkout Session. This can be a
customer ID, a cart ID, or similar, and can be used to reconcile the
Session with your internal systems.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) The client secret of your Checkout Session. Applies to Checkout Sessions with `ui_mode: embedded_page` or `ui_mode: elements`. For `ui_mode: embedded_page`, the client secret is to be used when initializing Stripe.js embedded checkout.
 For `ui_mode: elements`, use the client secret with [initCheckout](https://docs.stripe.com/js/custom_checkout/init) on your front end.
- `collected_information` (Attributes) Information about the customer collected within the Checkout Session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collected_information))
- `consent` (Attributes) Results of `consent_collection` for this session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consent))
- `consent_collection` (Attributes) When set, provides configuration for the Checkout Session to gather active consent from customers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consent_collection))
- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
- `currency_conversion` (Attributes) Currency conversion details for [Adaptive Pricing](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/adaptive-pricing) sessions created before 2025-03-31. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--currency_conversion))
- `custom_fields` (Attributes List) Collect additional information from your customer using custom fields. Up to 3 fields are supported. You can't set this parameter if `ui_mode` is `elements`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields))
- `custom_text` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_text))
- `customer` (String) The ID of the customer for this Session.
For Checkout Sessions in `subscription` mode or Checkout Sessions with `customer_creation` set as `always` in `payment` mode, Checkout
will create a new customer object based on information provided
during the payment flow unless an existing customer was provided when
the Session was created.
- `customer_account` (String) The ID of the account for this Session.
- `customer_creation` (String) Configure whether a Checkout Session creates a Customer when the Checkout Session completes. Possible values: `always`, `if_required`.
- `customer_details` (Attributes) The customer details including the customer's tax exempt status and the customer's tax IDs. Customer's address details are not present on Sessions in `setup` mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_details))
- `customer_email` (String) If provided, this value will be used when the Customer object is created.
If not provided, customers will be asked to enter their email address.
Use this parameter to prefill customer data if you already have an email
on file. To access information about the customer once the payment flow is
complete, use the `customer` attribute.
- `discounts` (Attributes List) List of coupons and promotion codes attached to the Checkout Session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--discounts))
- `excluded_payment_method_types` (List of String) A list of the types of payment methods (e.g., `card`) that should be excluded from this Checkout Session. This should only be used when payment methods for this Checkout Session are managed through the [Stripe Dashboard](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/payment_methods).
- `expires_at` (Number) The timestamp at which the Checkout Session will expire.
- `integration_identifier` (String) The integration identifier for this Checkout Session. Multiple Checkout Sessions can have the same integration identifier.
- `invoice` (String) ID of the invoice created by the Checkout Session, if it exists.
- `invoice_creation` (Attributes) Details on the state of invoice creation for the Checkout Session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invoice_creation))
- `line_items` (Attributes) The line items purchased by the customer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items))
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `locale` (String) The IETF language tag of the locale Checkout is displayed in. If blank or `auto`, the browser's locale is used. Possible values: `auto`, `bg`, `cs`, `da`, `de`, `el`, `en`, `en-GB`, `es`, `es-419`, `et`, `fi`, `fil`, `fr`, `fr-CA`, `hr`, `hu`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `lt`, `lv`, `ms`, `mt`, `nb`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt`, `pt-BR`, `ro`, `ru`, `sk`, `sl`, `sv`, `th`, `tr`, `vi`, `zh`, `zh-HK`, `zh-TW`.
- `managed_payments` (Attributes) Settings for Managed Payments for this Checkout Session and resulting [PaymentIntents](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/object), [Invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/object), and [Subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/object). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managed_payments))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `mode` (String) The mode of the Checkout Session. Possible values: `payment`, `setup`, `subscription`.
- `name_collection` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_collection))
- `optional_items` (Attributes List) The optional items presented to the customer at checkout. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--optional_items))
- `origin_context` (String) Where the user is coming from. This informs the optimizations that are applied to the session. Possible values: `mobile_app`, `web`.
- `payment_intent` (String) The ID of the PaymentIntent for Checkout Sessions in `payment` mode. You can't confirm or cancel the PaymentIntent for a Checkout Session. To cancel, [expire the Checkout Session](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/expire) instead.
- `payment_link` (String) The ID of the Payment Link that created this Session.
- `payment_method_collection` (String) Configure whether a Checkout Session should collect a payment method for sessions with mode `payment`. Defaults to `always`. Possible values: `always`, `if_required`.
- `payment_method_configuration_details` (Attributes) Information about the payment method configuration used for this Checkout session if using dynamic payment methods. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_configuration_details))
- `payment_method_options` (Attributes) Payment-method-specific configuration for the PaymentIntent or SetupIntent of this CheckoutSession. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options))
- `payment_method_types` (List of String) A list of the types of payment methods (e.g. card) this Checkout
Session is allowed to accept.
- `payment_status` (String) The payment status of the Checkout Session, one of `paid`, `unpaid`, or `no_payment_required`.
You can use this value to decide when to fulfill your customer's order. Possible values: `no_payment_required`, `paid`, `unpaid`.
- `permissions` (Attributes) This property is used to set up permissions for various actions (e.g., update) on the CheckoutSession object. For specific permissions, please refer to their dedicated subsections, such as `permissions.update_shipping_details`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `phone_number_collection` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_collection))
- `presentment_details` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--presentment_details))
- `recovered_from` (String) The ID of the original expired Checkout Session that triggered the recovery flow.
- `redirect_on_completion` (String) This parameter applies to `ui_mode: embedded_page`. Learn more about the [redirect behavior](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/custom-success-page?payment-ui=embedded-form) of embedded sessions. Defaults to `always`. Possible values: `always`, `if_required`, `never`.
- `return_url` (String) Applies to Checkout Sessions with `ui_mode: embedded_page` or `ui_mode: elements`. The URL to redirect your customer back to after they authenticate or cancel their payment on the payment method's app or site.
- `saved_payment_method_options` (Attributes) Controls saved payment method settings for the session. Only available in `payment` and `subscription` mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--saved_payment_method_options))
- `setup_intent` (String) The ID of the SetupIntent for Checkout Sessions in `setup` mode. You can't confirm or cancel the SetupIntent for a Checkout Session. To cancel, [expire the Checkout Session](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/expire) instead.
- `shipping_address_collection` (Attributes) When set, provides configuration for Checkout to collect a shipping address from a customer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_address_collection))
- `shipping_cost` (Attributes) The details of the customer cost of shipping, including the customer chosen ShippingRate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_cost))
- `shipping_options` (Attributes List) The shipping rate options applied to this Session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_options))
- `status` (String) The status of the Checkout Session, one of `open`, `complete`, or `expired`. Possible values: `complete`, `expired`, `open`.
- `submit_type` (String) Describes the type of transaction being performed by Checkout in order to customize
relevant text on the page, such as the submit button. `submit_type` can only be
specified on Checkout Sessions in `payment` mode. If blank or `auto`, `pay` is used. Possible values: `auto`, `book`, `donate`, `pay`, `subscribe`.
- `subscription` (String) The ID of the [Subscription](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions) for Checkout Sessions in `subscription` mode.
- `success_url` (String) The URL the customer will be directed to after the payment or
subscription creation is successful.
- `tax_id_collection` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tax_id_collection))
- `total_details` (Attributes) Tax and discount details for the computed total amount. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total_details))
- `ui_mode` (String) The UI mode of the Session. Defaults to `hosted_page`. Possible values: `elements`, `embedded_page`, `form`, `hosted_page`.
- `url` (String) The URL to the Checkout Session. Applies to Checkout Sessions with `ui_mode: hosted_page`. Redirect customers to this URL to take them to Checkout. If you’re using [Custom Domains](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/custom-domains), the URL will use your subdomain. Otherwise, it’ll use `checkout.stripe.com.`
This value is only present when the session is active.
- `wallet_options` (Attributes) Wallet-specific configuration for this Checkout Session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wallet_options))

### Nested Schema for `adaptive_pricing`

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--after_expiration--recovery"></a>
### Nested Schema for `after_expiration.recovery`

Read-Only:

- `allow_promotion_codes` (Boolean) Enables user redeemable promotion codes on the recovered Checkout Sessions. Defaults to `false`
- `enabled` (Boolean) If `true`, a recovery url will be generated to recover this Checkout Session if it
expires before a transaction is completed. It will be attached to the
Checkout Session object upon expiration.
- `expires_at` (Number) The timestamp at which the recovery URL will expire.
- `url` (String) URL that creates a new Checkout Session when clicked that is a copy of this expired Checkout Session



<a id="nestedatt--automatic_tax"></a>
### Nested Schema for `automatic_tax`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether automatic tax is enabled for the session
- `liability` (Attributes) The account that's liable for tax. If set, the business address and tax registrations required to perform the tax calculation are loaded from this account. The tax transaction is returned in the report of the connected account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--automatic_tax--liability))
- `provider` (String) The tax provider powering automatic tax.
- `status` (String) The status of the most recent automated tax calculation for this session. Possible values: `complete`, `failed`, `requires_location_inputs`.

<a id="nestedatt--automatic_tax--liability"></a>
### Nested Schema for `automatic_tax.liability`

Read-Only:

- `account` (String) The connected account being referenced when `type` is `account`.
- `type` (String) Type of the account referenced. Possible values: `account`, `self`.



<a id="nestedatt--branding_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branding_settings`

Read-Only:

- `background_color` (String) A hex color value starting with `#` representing the background color for the Checkout Session.
- `border_style` (String) The border style for the Checkout Session. Must be one of `rounded`, `rectangular`, or `pill`. Possible values: `pill`, `rectangular`, `rounded`.
- `button_color` (String) A hex color value starting with `#` representing the button color for the Checkout Session.
- `display_name` (String) The display name shown on the Checkout Session.
- `font_family` (String) The font family for the Checkout Session. Must be one of the [supported font families](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/customization/appearance?payment-ui=stripe-hosted#font-compatibility).
- `icon` (Attributes) The icon for the Checkout Session. You cannot set both `logo` and `icon`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branding_settings--icon))
- `logo` (Attributes) The logo for the Checkout Session. You cannot set both `logo` and `icon`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branding_settings--logo))

<a id="nestedatt--branding_settings--icon"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branding_settings.icon`

Read-Only:

- `file` (String) The ID of a [File upload](https://stripe.com/docs/api/files) representing the icon. Purpose must be `business_icon`. Required if `type` is `file` and disallowed otherwise.
- `type` (String) The type of image for the icon. Must be one of `file` or `url`. Possible values: `file`, `url`.
- `url` (String) The URL of the image. Present when `type` is `url`.


<a id="nestedatt--branding_settings--logo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `branding_settings.logo`

Read-Only:

- `file` (String) The ID of a [File upload](https://stripe.com/docs/api/files) representing the logo. Purpose must be `business_logo`. Required if `type` is `file` and disallowed otherwise.
- `type` (String) The type of image for the logo. Must be one of `file` or `url`. Possible values: `file`, `url`.
- `url` (String) The URL of the image. Present when `type` is `url`.

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--collected_information--shipping_details--address"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collected_information.shipping_details.address`

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--consent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consent`

Read-Only:

- `promotions` (String) If `opt_in`, the customer consents to receiving promotional communications
from the merchant about this Checkout Session. Possible values: `opt_in`, `opt_out`.
- `terms_of_service` (String) If `accepted`, the customer in this Checkout Session has agreed to the merchant's terms of service. Possible values: `accepted`.


<a id="nestedatt--consent_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consent_collection`

Read-Only:

- `payment_method_reuse_agreement` (Attributes) If set to `hidden`, it will hide legal text related to the reuse of a payment method. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consent_collection--payment_method_reuse_agreement))
- `promotions` (String) If set to `auto`, enables the collection of customer consent for promotional communications. The Checkout
Session will determine whether to display an option to opt into promotional communication
from the merchant depending on the customer's locale. Only available to US merchants and US customers. Possible values: `auto`, `none`.
- `terms_of_service` (String) If set to `required`, it requires customers to accept the terms of service before being able to pay. Possible values: `none`, `required`.

<a id="nestedatt--consent_collection--payment_method_reuse_agreement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consent_collection.payment_method_reuse_agreement`

Read-Only:

- `position` (String) Determines the position and visibility of the payment method reuse agreement in the UI. When set to `auto`, Stripe's defaults will be used. When set to `hidden`, the payment method reuse agreement text will always be hidden in the UI. Possible values: `auto`, `hidden`.



<a id="nestedatt--currency_conversion"></a>
### Nested Schema for `currency_conversion`

Read-Only:

- `amount_subtotal` (Number) Total of all items in source currency before discounts or taxes are applied.
- `amount_total` (Number) Total of all items in source currency after discounts and taxes are applied.
- `fx_rate` (String) Exchange rate used to convert source currency amounts to customer currency amounts
- `source_currency` (String) Creation currency of the CheckoutSession before localization

<a id="nestedatt--customer_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_details`

Read-Only:

- `address` (Attributes) The customer's address after a completed Checkout Session. Note: This property is populated only for sessions on or after March 30, 2022. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_details--address))
- `business_name` (String) The customer's business name after a completed Checkout Session.
- `email` (String) The email associated with the Customer, if one exists, on the Checkout Session after a completed Checkout Session or at time of session expiry.
Otherwise, if the customer has consented to promotional content, this value is the most recent valid email provided by the customer on the Checkout form.
- `individual_name` (String) The customer's individual name after a completed Checkout Session.
- `name` (String) The customer's name after a completed Checkout Session. Note: This property is populated only for sessions on or after March 30, 2022.
- `phone` (String) The customer's phone number after a completed Checkout Session.
- `tax_exempt` (String) The customer’s tax exempt status after a completed Checkout Session. Possible values: `exempt`, `none`, `reverse`.
- `tax_ids` (Attributes List) The customer’s tax IDs after a completed Checkout Session. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_details--tax_ids))

- `footer` (String) Footer displayed on the invoice.
- `issuer` (Attributes) The connected account that issues the invoice. The invoice is presented with the branding and support information of the specified account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invoice_creation--invoice_data--issuer))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `rendering_options` (Attributes) Options for invoice PDF rendering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invoice_creation--invoice_data--rendering_options))

<a id="nestedatt--invoice_creation--invoice_data--issuer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `invoice_creation.invoice_data.issuer`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Type of the account referenced. Possible values: `account`, `self`.

### Nested Schema for `invoice_creation.invoice_data.rendering_options`

<a id="nestedatt--line_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items`

Read-Only:

- `data` (Attributes List) Details about each object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data))
- `has_more` (Boolean) True if this list has another page of items after this one that can be fetched.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Always has the value `list`. Possible values: `list`.
- `url` (String) The URL where this list can be accessed.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data`

Read-Only:

- `adjustable_quantity` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--adjustable_quantity))
- `amount_discount` (Number) Total discount amount applied. If no discounts were applied, defaults to 0.
- `amount_subtotal` (Number) Total before any discounts or taxes are applied.
- `amount_tax` (Number) Total tax amount applied. If no tax was applied, defaults to 0.
- `amount_total` (Number) Total after discounts and taxes.
- `currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
- `description` (String) An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users. Defaults to product name.
- `discounts` (Attributes List) The discounts applied to the line item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--discounts))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `item`.
- `price` (Attributes) The price used to generate the line item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price))
- `quantity` (Number) The quantity of products being purchased.
- `taxes` (Attributes List) The taxes applied to the line item. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--taxes))

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--adjustable_quantity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.adjustable_quantity`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `maximum` (Number)
- `minimum` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--discounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.discounts`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount discounted.
- `discount` (Attributes) A discount represents the actual application of a [coupon](https://docs.stripe.com/api#coupons) or [promotion code](https://docs.stripe.com/api#promotion_codes).
It contains information about when the discount began, when it will end, and what it is applied to. Related guide: [Applying discounts to subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/discounts) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--discounts--discount))

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--discounts--discount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.discounts.discount`

Read-Only:

- `checkout_session` (String) The Checkout session that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular session in payment mode. Not present for subscription mode.
- `customer` (String) The ID of the customer associated with this discount.
- `customer_account` (String) The ID of the account representing the customer associated with this discount.
- `end` (Number) If the coupon has a duration of `repeating`, the date that this discount will end. If the coupon has a duration of `once` or `forever`, this attribute will be null.
- `id` (String) The ID of the discount object. Discounts can't be fetched by ID. Use `expand[]=discounts` in API calls to expand discount IDs in an array.
- `invoice` (String) The invoice that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice.
- `invoice_item` (String) The invoice item `id` (or invoice line item `id` for invoice line items of type='subscription') that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice item or invoice line item.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `discount`.
- `promotion_code` (String) The promotion code applied to create this discount.
- `source` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--discounts--discount--source))
- `start` (Number) Date that the coupon was applied.
- `subscription` (String) The subscription that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription.
- `subscription_item` (String) The subscription item that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription item.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--discounts--discount--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.discounts.discount.source`

Read-Only:

- `coupon` (String) The coupon that was redeemed to create this discount.
- `type` (String) The source type of the discount. Possible values: `coupon`.




<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the price can be used for new purchases.
- `billing_scheme` (String) Describes how to compute the price per period. Either `per_unit` or `tiered`. `per_unit` indicates that the fixed amount (specified in `unit_amount` or `unit_amount_decimal`) will be charged per unit in `quantity` (for prices with `usage_type=licensed`), or per unit of total usage (for prices with `usage_type=metered`). `tiered` indicates that the unit pricing will be computed using a tiering strategy as defined using the `tiers` and `tiers_mode` attributes. Possible values: `per_unit`, `tiered`.
- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).
- `currency_options` (Attributes Map) Prices defined in each available currency option. Each key must be a three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) and a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price--currency_options))
- `custom_unit_amount` (Attributes) When set, provides configuration for the amount to be adjusted by the customer during Checkout Sessions and Payment Links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price--custom_unit_amount))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `lookup_key` (String) A lookup key used to retrieve prices dynamically from a static string. This may be up to 200 characters.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `nickname` (String) A brief description of the price, hidden from customers.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `price`.
- `product` (String) The ID of the product this price is associated with.
- `recurring` (Attributes) The recurring components of a price such as `interval` and `usage_type`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price--recurring))
- `tax_behavior` (String) Only required if a [default tax behavior](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/products-prices-tax-categories-tax-behavior#setting-a-default-tax-behavior-(recommended)) was not provided in the Stripe Tax settings. Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`, or `unspecified`. Once specified as either `inclusive` or `exclusive`, it cannot be changed. Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`, `unspecified`.
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Each element represents a pricing tier. This parameter requires `billing_scheme` to be set to `tiered`. See also the documentation for `billing_scheme`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price--tiers))
- `tiers_mode` (String) Defines if the tiering price should be `graduated` or `volume` based. In `volume`-based tiering, the maximum quantity within a period determines the per unit price. In `graduated` tiering, pricing can change as the quantity grows. Possible values: `graduated`, `volume`.
- `transform_quantity` (Attributes) Apply a transformation to the reported usage or set quantity before computing the amount billed. Cannot be combined with `tiers`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price--transform_quantity))
- `type` (String) One of `one_time` or `recurring` depending on whether the price is for a one-time purchase or a recurring (subscription) purchase. Possible values: `one_time`, `recurring`.
- `unit_amount` (Number) The unit amount in cents (or local equivalent) to be charged, represented as a whole integer if possible. Only set if `billing_scheme=per_unit`.
- `unit_amount_decimal` (String) The unit amount in cents (or local equivalent) to be charged, represented as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. Only set if `billing_scheme=per_unit`.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price--currency_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price.currency_options`

Read-Only:

- `custom_unit_amount` (Attributes) When set, provides configuration for the amount to be adjusted by the customer during Checkout Sessions and Payment Links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price--currency_options--custom_unit_amount))
- `tax_behavior` (String) Only required if a [default tax behavior](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/products-prices-tax-categories-tax-behavior#setting-a-default-tax-behavior-(recommended)) was not provided in the Stripe Tax settings. Specifies whether the price is considered inclusive of taxes or exclusive of taxes. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`, or `unspecified`. Once specified as either `inclusive` or `exclusive`, it cannot be changed. Possible values: `exclusive`, `inclusive`, `unspecified`.
- `tiers` (Attributes List) Each element represents a pricing tier. This parameter requires `billing_scheme` to be set to `tiered`. See also the documentation for `billing_scheme`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--price--currency_options--tiers))
- `unit_amount` (Number) The unit amount in cents (or local equivalent) to be charged, represented as a whole integer if possible. Only set if `billing_scheme=per_unit`.
- `unit_amount_decimal` (String) The unit amount in cents (or local equivalent) to be charged, represented as a decimal string with at most 12 decimal places. Only set if `billing_scheme=per_unit`.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price--currency_options--custom_unit_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price.currency_options.custom_unit_amount`

Read-Only:

- `maximum` (Number) The maximum unit amount the customer can specify for this item.
- `minimum` (Number) The minimum unit amount the customer can specify for this item. Must be at least the minimum charge amount.
- `preset` (Number) The starting unit amount which can be updated by the customer.


<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price--currency_options--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price.currency_options.tiers`

Read-Only:

- `flat_amount` (Number) Price for the entire tier.
- `flat_amount_decimal` (String) Same as `flat_amount`, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.
- `unit_amount` (Number) Per unit price for units relevant to the tier.
- `unit_amount_decimal` (String) Same as `unit_amount`, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.
- `up_to` (Number) Up to and including to this quantity will be contained in the tier.



<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price--custom_unit_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price.custom_unit_amount`

Read-Only:

- `maximum` (Number) The maximum unit amount the customer can specify for this item.
- `minimum` (Number) The minimum unit amount the customer can specify for this item. Must be at least the minimum charge amount.
- `preset` (Number) The starting unit amount which can be updated by the customer.


<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price--recurring"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price.recurring`

Read-Only:

- `interval` (String) The frequency at which a subscription is billed. One of `day`, `week`, `month` or `year`. Possible values: `day`, `month`, `week`, `year`.
- `interval_count` (Number) The number of intervals (specified in the `interval` attribute) between subscription billings. For example, `interval=month` and `interval_count=3` bills every 3 months.
- `meter` (String) The meter tracking the usage of a metered price
- `usage_type` (String) Configures how the quantity per period should be determined. Can be either `metered` or `licensed`. `licensed` automatically bills the `quantity` set when adding it to a subscription. `metered` aggregates the total usage based on usage records. Defaults to `licensed`. Possible values: `licensed`, `metered`.


<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price--tiers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price.tiers`

Read-Only:

- `flat_amount` (Number) Price for the entire tier.
- `flat_amount_decimal` (String) Same as `flat_amount`, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.
- `unit_amount` (Number) Per unit price for units relevant to the tier.
- `unit_amount_decimal` (String) Same as `unit_amount`, but contains a decimal value with at most 12 decimal places.
- `up_to` (Number) Up to and including to this quantity will be contained in the tier.


<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--price--transform_quantity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.price.transform_quantity`

Read-Only:

- `divide_by` (Number) Divide usage by this number.
- `round` (String) After division, either round the result `up` or `down`. Possible values: `down`, `up`.



<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--taxes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.taxes`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount of tax applied for this rate.
- `rate` (Attributes) Tax rates can be applied to [invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing/taxes/tax-rates), [subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/taxes/tax-rates) and [Checkout Sessions](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/use-manual-tax-rates) to collect tax. Related guide: [Tax rates](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/taxes/tax-rates) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--taxes--rate))
- `taxability_reason` (String) The reasoning behind this tax, for example, if the product is tax exempt. The possible values for this field may be extended as new tax rules are supported. Possible values: `customer_exempt`, `not_collecting`, `not_subject_to_tax`, `not_supported`, `portion_product_exempt`, `portion_reduced_rated`, `portion_standard_rated`, `product_exempt`, `product_exempt_holiday`, `proportionally_rated`, `reduced_rated`, `reverse_charge`, `standard_rated`, `taxable_basis_reduced`, `zero_rated`.
- `taxable_amount` (Number) The amount on which tax is calculated, in cents (or local equivalent).

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--taxes--rate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.taxes.rate`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. When set to `false`, this tax rate cannot be used with new applications or Checkout Sessions, but will still work for subscriptions and invoices that already have it set.
- `country` (String) Two-letter country code ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)).
- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `description` (String) An arbitrary string attached to the tax rate for your internal use only. It will not be visible to your customers.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the tax rates as it will appear to your customer on their receipt email, PDF, and the hosted invoice page.
- `effective_percentage` (Number) Actual/effective tax rate percentage out of 100. For tax calculations with automatic_tax[enabled]=true,
this percentage reflects the rate actually used to calculate tax based on the product's taxability
and whether the user is registered to collect taxes in the corresponding jurisdiction.
- `flat_amount` (Attributes) The amount of the tax rate when the `rate_type` is `flat_amount`. Tax rates with `rate_type` `percentage` can vary based on the transaction, resulting in this field being `null`. This field exposes the amount and currency of the flat tax rate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--data--taxes--rate--flat_amount))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `inclusive` (Boolean) This specifies if the tax rate is inclusive or exclusive.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction for the tax rate. You can use this label field for tax reporting purposes. It also appears on your customer’s invoice.
- `jurisdiction_level` (String) The level of the jurisdiction that imposes this tax rate. Will be `null` for manually defined tax rates. Possible values: `city`, `country`, `county`, `district`, `multiple`, `state`.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `tax_rate`.
- `percentage` (Number) Tax rate percentage out of 100. For tax calculations with automatic_tax[enabled]=true, this percentage includes the statutory tax rate of non-taxable jurisdictions.
- `rate_type` (String) Indicates the type of tax rate applied to the taxable amount. This value can be `null` when no tax applies to the location. This field is only present for TaxRates created by Stripe Tax. Possible values: `flat_amount`, `percentage`.
- `state` (String) [ISO 3166-2 subdivision code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2), without country prefix. For example, "NY" for New York, United States.
- `tax_type` (String) The high-level tax type, such as `vat` or `sales_tax`. Possible values: `amusement_tax`, `communications_tax`, `digital_excise_tax`, `gst`, `hst`, `igst`, `jct`, `lease_tax`, `mass_transit_parking_tax`, `parking_tax`, `pst`, `qst`, `retail_delivery_fee`, `rst`, `sales_tax`, `service_tax`, `utility_users_tax`, `vat`.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--data--taxes--rate--flat_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.data.taxes.rate.flat_amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount of the tax when the `rate_type` is `flat_amount`. This positive integer represents how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a zero-decimal currency). The amount value supports up to eight digits (e.g., a value of 99999999 for a USD charge of $999,999.99).
- `currency` (String) Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.






<a id="nestedatt--managed_payments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `managed_payments`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to `true` to enable [Managed Payments](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/managed-payments), Stripe's merchant of record solution, for this session.


<a id="nestedatt--name_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_collection`

Read-Only:

- `business` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_collection--business))
- `individual` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_collection--individual))

<a id="nestedatt--name_collection--business"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_collection.business`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether business name collection is enabled for the session
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether the customer is required to complete the field before completing the Checkout Session. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--name_collection--individual"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_collection.individual`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether individual name collection is enabled for the session
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether the customer is required to complete the field before completing the Checkout Session. Defaults to `false`.



<a id="nestedatt--optional_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `optional_items`

Read-Only:

- `adjustable_quantity` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--optional_items--adjustable_quantity))
- `price` (String)
- `quantity` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--optional_items--adjustable_quantity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `optional_items.adjustable_quantity`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to true if the quantity can be adjusted to any non-negative integer.
- `maximum` (Number) The maximum quantity of this item the customer can purchase. By default this value is 99. You can specify a value up to 999999.
- `minimum` (Number) The minimum quantity of this item the customer must purchase, if they choose to purchase it. Because this item is optional, the customer will always be able to remove it from their order, even if the `minimum` configured here is greater than 0. By default this value is 0.



<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_configuration_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_configuration_details`

<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_options--acss_debit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options.acss_debit`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency supported by the bank account. Returned when the Session is in `setup` mode. Possible values: `cad`, `usd`.
- `mandate_options` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options--acss_debit--mandate_options))
- `setup_future_usage` (String) Indicates that you intend to make future payments with this PaymentIntent's payment method. If you provide a Customer with the PaymentIntent, you can use this parameter to [attach the payment method](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/save-during-payment) to the Customer after the PaymentIntent is confirmed and the customer completes any required actions. If you don't provide a Customer, you can still [attach](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/attach) the payment method to a Customer after the transaction completes. If the payment method is `card_present` and isn't a digital wallet, Stripe creates and attaches a [generated_card](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-generated_card) payment method representing the card to the Customer instead. When processing card payments, Stripe uses `setup_future_usage` to help you comply with regional legislation and network rules, such as [SCA](https://docs.stripe.com/strong-customer-authentication). Possible values: `none`, `off_session`, `on_session`.
- `target_date` (String) Controls when Stripe will attempt to debit the funds from the customer's account. The date must be a string in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date must be in the future and between 3 and 15 calendar days from now.
- `verification_method` (String) Bank account verification method. The default value is `automatic`. Possible values: `automatic`, `instant`, `microdeposits`.

<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_options--acss_debit--mandate_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options.acss_debit.mandate_options`

Read-Only:

- `custom_mandate_url` (String) A URL for custom mandate text
- `default_for` (List of String) List of Stripe products where this mandate can be selected automatically. Returned when the Session is in `setup` mode.
- `interval_description` (String) Description of the interval. Only required if the 'payment_schedule' parameter is 'interval' or 'combined'.
- `payment_schedule` (String) Payment schedule for the mandate. Possible values: `combined`, `interval`, `sporadic`.
- `transaction_type` (String) Transaction type of the mandate. Possible values: `business`, `personal`.

### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options.card`

Read-Only:

- `capture_method` (String) Controls when the funds will be captured from the customer's account. Possible values: `manual`.
- `installments` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options--card--installments))
- `request_extended_authorization` (String) Request ability to [capture beyond the standard authorization validity window](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/extended-authorization) for this CheckoutSession. Possible values: `if_available`, `never`.
- `request_incremental_authorization` (String) Request ability to [increment the authorization](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/incremental-authorization) for this CheckoutSession. Possible values: `if_available`, `never`.
- `request_multicapture` (String) Request ability to make [multiple captures](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/multicapture) for this CheckoutSession. Possible values: `if_available`, `never`.
- `request_overcapture` (String) Request ability to [overcapture](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/overcapture) for this CheckoutSession. Possible values: `if_available`, `never`.
- `request_three_d_secure` (String) We strongly recommend that you rely on our SCA Engine to automatically prompt your customers for authentication based on risk level and [other requirements](https://docs.stripe.com/strong-customer-authentication). However, if you wish to request 3D Secure based on logic from your own fraud engine, provide this option. If not provided, this value defaults to `automatic`. Read our guide on [manually requesting 3D Secure](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/3d-secure/authentication-flow#manual-three-ds) for more information on how this configuration interacts with Radar and our SCA Engine. Possible values: `any`, `automatic`, `challenge`.
- `restrictions` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options--card--restrictions))
- `setup_future_usage` (String) Indicates that you intend to make future payments with this PaymentIntent's payment method. If you provide a Customer with the PaymentIntent, you can use this parameter to [attach the payment method](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/save-during-payment) to the Customer after the PaymentIntent is confirmed and the customer completes any required actions. If you don't provide a Customer, you can still [attach](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/attach) the payment method to a Customer after the transaction completes. If the payment method is `card_present` and isn't a digital wallet, Stripe creates and attaches a [generated_card](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-generated_card) payment method representing the card to the Customer instead. When processing card payments, Stripe uses `setup_future_usage` to help you comply with regional legislation and network rules, such as [SCA](https://docs.stripe.com/strong-customer-authentication). Possible values: `none`, `off_session`, `on_session`.
- `statement_descriptor_suffix_kana` (String) Provides information about a card payment that customers see on their statements. Concatenated with the Kana prefix (shortened Kana descriptor) or Kana statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 22 characters. On card statements, the *concatenation* of both prefix and suffix (including separators) will appear truncated to 22 characters.
- `statement_descriptor_suffix_kanji` (String) Provides information about a card payment that customers see on their statements. Concatenated with the Kanji prefix (shortened Kanji descriptor) or Kanji statement descriptor that’s set on the account to form the complete statement descriptor. Maximum 17 characters. On card statements, the *concatenation* of both prefix and suffix (including separators) will appear truncated to 17 characters.

<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_options--payto--mandate_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options.payto.mandate_options`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount that will be collected. It is required when `amount_type` is `fixed`.
- `amount_type` (String) The type of amount that will be collected. The amount charged must be exact or up to the value of `amount` param for `fixed` or `maximum` type respectively. Defaults to `maximum`. Possible values: `fixed`, `maximum`.
- `end_date` (String) Date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, after which payments will not be collected. Defaults to no end date.
- `payment_schedule` (String) The periodicity at which payments will be collected. Defaults to `adhoc`. Possible values: `adhoc`, `annual`, `daily`, `fortnightly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `semi_annual`, `weekly`.
- `payments_per_period` (Number) The number of payments that will be made during a payment period. Defaults to 1 except for when `payment_schedule` is `adhoc`. In that case, it defaults to no limit.
- `purpose` (String) The purpose for which payments are made. Has a default value based on your merchant category code. Possible values: `dependant_support`, `government`, `loan`, `mortgage`, `other`, `pension`, `personal`, `retail`, `salary`, `tax`, `utility`.
- `start_date` (String) Date, in YYYY-MM-DD format, from which payments will be collected. Defaults to confirmation time.

- `expires_after_seconds` (Number) The number of seconds after which Pix payment will expire.
- `mandate_options` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options--pix--mandate_options))

When processing card payments, Stripe uses `setup_future_usage` to help you comply with regional legislation and network rules, such as [SCA](https://docs.stripe.com/strong-customer-authentication). <a id="nestedatt--payment_method_options--pix--mandate_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options.pix.mandate_options`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount to be charged for future payments.
- `amount_includes_iof` (String) Determines if the amount includes the IOF tax. Possible values: `always`, `never`.
- `amount_type` (String) Type of amount. Possible values: `fixed`, `maximum`.
- `currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase.
- `end_date` (String) Date when the mandate expires and no further payments will be charged, in `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `payment_schedule` (String) Schedule at which the future payments will be charged. Possible values: `halfyearly`, `monthly`, `quarterly`, `weekly`, `yearly`.
- `reference` (String) Subscription name displayed to buyers in their bank app.
- `start_date` (String) Start date of the mandate, in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

If you provide a Customer with the PaymentIntent, you can use this parameter to [attach the payment method](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/save-during-payment) to the Customer after the PaymentIntent is confirmed and the customer completes any required actions. If you don't provide a Customer, you can still [attach](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_methods/attach) the payment method to a Customer after the transaction completes. If the payment method is `card_present` and isn't a digital wallet, Stripe creates and attaches a [generated_card](https://docs.stripe.com/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-generated_card) payment method representing the card to the Customer instead. When processing card payments, Stripe uses `setup_future_usage` to help you comply with regional legislation and network rules, such as [SCA](https://docs.stripe.com/strong-customer-authentication). Possible values: `none`, `off_session`, `on_session`.
- `target_date` (String) Controls when Stripe will attempt to debit the funds from the customer's account. The date must be a string in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date must be in the future and between 3 and 15 calendar days from now.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `update_shipping_details` (String) Determines which entity is allowed to update the shipping details. Default is `client_only`. Stripe Checkout client will automatically update the shipping details. If set to `server_only`, only your server is allowed to update the shipping details. This parameter is only supported when `ui_mode=elements`. Possible values: `client_only`, `server_only`.


<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_collection`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether phone number collection is enabled for the session


<a id="nestedatt--presentment_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `presentment_details`

Read-Only:

- `presentment_amount` (Number) Amount intended to be collected by this payment, denominated in `presentment_currency`.
- `presentment_currency` (String) Currency presented to the customer during payment.


<a id="nestedatt--saved_payment_method_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `saved_payment_method_options`

Read-Only:

- `allow_redisplay_filters` (List of String) Uses the `allow_redisplay` value of each saved payment method to filter the set presented to a returning customer. By default, only saved payment methods with ’allow_redisplay: ‘always’ are shown in Checkout.
- `payment_method_remove` (String) Enable customers to choose if they wish to remove their saved payment methods. Disabled by default. Possible values: `disabled`, `enabled`.
- `payment_method_save` (String) Enable customers to choose if they wish to save their payment method for future use. Disabled by default. Possible values: `disabled`, `enabled`.


<a id="nestedatt--shipping_address_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_address_collection`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_countries` (List of String) An array of two-letter ISO country codes representing which countries Checkout should provide as options for
shipping locations. Unsupported country codes: `AS, CX, CC, CU, HM, IR, KP, MH, FM, NF, MP, PW, SY, UM, VI`.


<a id="nestedatt--shipping_cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_cost`

Read-Only:

- `amount_subtotal` (Number) Total shipping cost before any discounts or taxes are applied.
- `amount_tax` (Number) Total tax amount applied due to shipping costs. If no tax was applied, defaults to 0.
- `amount_total` (Number) Total shipping cost after discounts and taxes are applied.
- `shipping_rate` (String) The ID of the ShippingRate for this order.
- `taxes` (Attributes List) The taxes applied to the shipping rate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_cost--taxes))

<a id="nestedatt--shipping_cost--taxes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_cost.taxes`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount of tax applied for this rate.
- `rate` (Attributes) Tax rates can be applied to [invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing/taxes/tax-rates), [subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/taxes/tax-rates) and [Checkout Sessions](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/use-manual-tax-rates) to collect tax. Related guide: [Tax rates](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/taxes/tax-rates) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_cost--taxes--rate))
- `taxability_reason` (String) The reasoning behind this tax, for example, if the product is tax exempt. The possible values for this field may be extended as new tax rules are supported. Possible values: `customer_exempt`, `not_collecting`, `not_subject_to_tax`, `not_supported`, `portion_product_exempt`, `portion_reduced_rated`, `portion_standard_rated`, `product_exempt`, `product_exempt_holiday`, `proportionally_rated`, `reduced_rated`, `reverse_charge`, `standard_rated`, `taxable_basis_reduced`, `zero_rated`.
- `taxable_amount` (Number) The amount on which tax is calculated, in cents (or local equivalent).

<a id="nestedatt--shipping_cost--taxes--rate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_cost.taxes.rate`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. When set to `false`, this tax rate cannot be used with new applications or Checkout Sessions, but will still work for subscriptions and invoices that already have it set.
- `country` (String) Two-letter country code ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)).
- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `description` (String) An arbitrary string attached to the tax rate for your internal use only. It will not be visible to your customers.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the tax rates as it will appear to your customer on their receipt email, PDF, and the hosted invoice page.
- `effective_percentage` (Number) Actual/effective tax rate percentage out of 100. For tax calculations with automatic_tax[enabled]=true,
this percentage reflects the rate actually used to calculate tax based on the product's taxability
and whether the user is registered to collect taxes in the corresponding jurisdiction.
- `flat_amount` (Attributes) The amount of the tax rate when the `rate_type` is `flat_amount`. Tax rates with `rate_type` `percentage` can vary based on the transaction, resulting in this field being `null`. This field exposes the amount and currency of the flat tax rate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_cost--taxes--rate--flat_amount))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `inclusive` (Boolean) This specifies if the tax rate is inclusive or exclusive.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction for the tax rate. You can use this label field for tax reporting purposes. It also appears on your customer’s invoice.
- `jurisdiction_level` (String) The level of the jurisdiction that imposes this tax rate. Will be `null` for manually defined tax rates. Possible values: `city`, `country`, `county`, `district`, `multiple`, `state`.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `tax_rate`.
- `percentage` (Number) Tax rate percentage out of 100. For tax calculations with automatic_tax[enabled]=true, this percentage includes the statutory tax rate of non-taxable jurisdictions.
- `rate_type` (String) Indicates the type of tax rate applied to the taxable amount. This value can be `null` when no tax applies to the location. This field is only present for TaxRates created by Stripe Tax. Possible values: `flat_amount`, `percentage`.
- `state` (String) [ISO 3166-2 subdivision code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2), without country prefix. For example, "NY" for New York, United States.
- `tax_type` (String) The high-level tax type, such as `vat` or `sales_tax`. Possible values: `amusement_tax`, `communications_tax`, `digital_excise_tax`, `gst`, `hst`, `igst`, `jct`, `lease_tax`, `mass_transit_parking_tax`, `parking_tax`, `pst`, `qst`, `retail_delivery_fee`, `rst`, `sales_tax`, `service_tax`, `utility_users_tax`, `vat`.

<a id="nestedatt--shipping_cost--taxes--rate--flat_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_cost.taxes.rate.flat_amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount of the tax when the `rate_type` is `flat_amount`. This positive integer represents how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a zero-decimal currency). The amount value supports up to eight digits (e.g., a value of 99999999 for a USD charge of $999,999.99).
- `currency` (String) Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.





<a id="nestedatt--shipping_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_options`

Read-Only:

- `shipping_amount` (Number) A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to charge.
- `shipping_rate` (String) The shipping rate.


<a id="nestedatt--tax_id_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tax_id_collection`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether tax ID collection is enabled for the session
- `required` (String) Indicates whether a tax ID is required on the payment page Possible values: `if_supported`, `never`.


<a id="nestedatt--total_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `total_details`

Read-Only:

- `amount_discount` (Number) This is the sum of all the discounts.
- `amount_shipping` (Number) This is the sum of all the shipping amounts.
- `amount_tax` (Number) This is the sum of all the tax amounts.
- `breakdown` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total_details--breakdown))

<a id="nestedatt--total_details--breakdown"></a>
### Nested Schema for `total_details.breakdown`

Read-Only:

- `discounts` (Attributes List) The aggregated discounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total_details--breakdown--discounts))
- `taxes` (Attributes List) The aggregated tax amounts by rate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total_details--breakdown--taxes))

<a id="nestedatt--total_details--breakdown--discounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `total_details.breakdown.discounts`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount discounted.
- `discount` (Attributes) A discount represents the actual application of a [coupon](https://docs.stripe.com/api#coupons) or [promotion code](https://docs.stripe.com/api#promotion_codes).
It contains information about when the discount began, when it will end, and what it is applied to. Related guide: [Applying discounts to subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/discounts) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total_details--breakdown--discounts--discount))

<a id="nestedatt--total_details--breakdown--discounts--discount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `total_details.breakdown.discounts.discount`

Read-Only:

- `checkout_session` (String) The Checkout session that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular session in payment mode. Not present for subscription mode.
- `customer` (String) The ID of the customer associated with this discount.
- `customer_account` (String) The ID of the account representing the customer associated with this discount.
- `end` (Number) If the coupon has a duration of `repeating`, the date that this discount will end. If the coupon has a duration of `once` or `forever`, this attribute will be null.
- `id` (String) The ID of the discount object. Discounts can't be fetched by ID. Use `expand[]=discounts` in API calls to expand discount IDs in an array.
- `invoice` (String) The invoice that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice.
- `invoice_item` (String) The invoice item `id` (or invoice line item `id` for invoice line items of type='subscription') that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice item or invoice line item.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `discount`.
- `promotion_code` (String) The promotion code applied to create this discount.
- `source` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--total_details--breakdown--discounts--discount--source))
- `start` (Number) Date that the coupon was applied.
- `subscription` (String) The subscription that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription.
- `subscription_item` (String) The subscription item that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription item.

<a id="nestedatt--total_details--breakdown--discounts--discount--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `total_details.breakdown.discounts.discount.source`

Read-Only:

- `coupon` (String) The coupon that was redeemed to create this discount.
- `type` (String) The source type of the discount. Possible values: `coupon`.

This positive integer represents how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a zero-decimal currency). The amount value supports up to eight digits (e.g., a value of 99999999 for a USD charge of $999,999.99).
- `currency` (String) Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
